questions.q1: Can I try Pro before paying?
questions.a1: Yes, you can start with the free plan and upgrade to Pro whenever you need to.
questions.q2: How does the adaptation limit work?
questions.a2: The free plan includes 3 adaptations per month. It resets automatically every month.
questions.q3: Are adaptations valid for educational inspection?
questions.a3: Yes, adaptations follow the UDL and LOMLOE framework. The report includes the rationale for every change.
questions.a4: Yes, no lock-in. Cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of the billing period.
questions.a5: We accept exams in PDF and text format. The AI adapts the content while preserving the original structure.
